scheduled_maintenances.name: TNX-AU1 Interconnect Services - Network Infrastructure Upgrade

incident_updates.body: We’re conducting a planned maintenance in Australia (TNX-AU1) between 5:00 AM and 9:00 AM Pacific Time on 01/22/2027. During the maintenance window, customers using TNX-AU1 interconnect services—including those with redundant connections—could experience a brief (30–60 second) service disruption while we perform a Junos OS upgrade on the AU1 Edge1 Juniper QFX10K network gear.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Russia SMS Carrier Maintenance - Tele2

incident_updates.body: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

The Tele2 network in Russia is conducting a series of planned maintenances from 02 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 30 November 2026 at 16:00 PST. During the maintenance window, there could be intermittent delays delivering SMS to Tele2 Belgium handsets.

Note, the maintenance will be carried out on each of the following dates and times:

02 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 02 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
09 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 09 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
11 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 11 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
16 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 16 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
18 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 18 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
23 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 23 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
25 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 25 November 2026 at 16:00 PST
30 November 2026 at 12:00 PST until 30 November 2026 at 16:00 PST

We are aware of the short notice and are working with our Carrier Partners to provide earlier notification where possible.
